notes: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as PlayStation publishes it. Every guide below is written for this entry in our own words, from the cited source; a guide never copies its source's text. 'hidden' marks the 28 trophies PlayStation hides until earned (12 story + 16 side). 'kind' drives the tracker filters. 'stage' is the roadmap step (1 story, 2 100% cleanup, 3 strangers & cleanup). 'count' is the number the trophy tracker counts. Only Positive Mental Attitude is possibly missable.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this platinum pops automatically. No multiplayer and no DLC is needed for it. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4 out of 10 in difficulty and about 200 hours, with a single playthrough enough, and Push Square puts the total at 250 hours or more. The long pole is A Long Road, the gold for 100% completion, so treat this platinum as the reward for finishing the roadmap, not a trophy you chase on its own.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, impossible to miss. It pops when you finish the first main mission of Chapter 1, Gone Fishing. Just play the opening mission through to its end; no side objective or rating is needed, because this game has no mission medals and no mission replay.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 1. PowerPyx notes it pops a little late, just after you clear the first main mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?, so do not worry if it does not appear the moment the chapter title card changes. Nothing about it can be missed.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies it pops shortly after you start Chapter 3, once you clear the first mission, Welcome to Vice City. Keep playing the main missions and it arrives on its own.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 3. PowerPyx notes it pops after you clear the first two main missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life. No preparation is needed; finishing the chapter is the whole requirement.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 4. PowerPyx places its unlock at the end of the chapter's final main mission, Starting From Zero. Play the chapter's missions in order and the trophy follows the story.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing the final mission of the game. It is the gold that closes the story, and PowerPyx lists it under the finale mission Starting From Zero. Once the credits roll you are dropped back into free roam, where every remaining trophy can still be earned.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. It pops during the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run, when that mission ends. There is no way to miss it and no extra objective inside the mission.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. It pops during the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist, when the heist is done. Play the mission through; the trophy is tied to completing it, not to how you play it.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. It pops during the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play, when that mission ends. As with every story trophy here, it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. It pops during the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners, when the mission is complete. No side task or collectible is attached to it.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. It pops during the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown, when that mission ends. Keep following the main-mission icons and it unlocks by itself.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. It pops during the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory, when the mission is complete. It is the last of the mission-named story trophies before the finale.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set, and the last one most players earn. The 100% checklist only becomes visible after the story, under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — but progress you made during the story already counts toward it, and nothing on it is missable. PowerPyx stresses the checklist is lenient, closer to 60% true completion: most side quests are not required, and of the collectibles you typically need only 70-80%. The big numbers are any 100 optional missions (there are far more), scanning any 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles with the WAiNK app, studying any 100 of the 255 animals through binoculars, any 70 of the 80 challenges, and 300 stunts. The only lines that demand everything are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. Work through the checklist line by line after the story and this gold follows.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida. PowerPyx breaks them into four kinds: 130 stunt jumps over ramps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings, and 25 base jumps. You can mix the kinds freely, and the fastest to clear are the under-bridge flights. The 100% checklist needs 300 stunts, so keep going past 250. Track progress by region under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, and on the map under Exploration, then Stunt Spots, where each completed stunt stays marked with its own name.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: The trophy tracker counts 9 activity types, and you must try each one at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race or drone race, and performing a stunt. Check them under Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities, where scrolling over each type shows how many you have done. Most are introduced by the story or marked with blue dumbbell icons when you unfog the map, and while working on the other trophies you will do one of each almost by accident.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 shooting range challenges, spread across 12 shooting range locations. PowerPyx has a dedicated page mapping every range and every gold medal, and notes the medals are not too difficult. The 100% checklist also needs every shooting range, so this silver is earned on the way to A Long Road rather than as a separate grind.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations — 42 drone races in total, three per location. PowerPyx maps all 14 locations and notes the 100% checklist needs every drone race too, so the trophy and the checklist are finished together. Learn each course's corners once and the wins come steadily.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race location counts once, so repeating the same course does not help. PowerPyx counts 40 unique race locations across Leonida. Pick the short, flat courses first, learn their braking points, and work through the map location by location; the wins also feed the race requirement of the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 main mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he will send a text message marking a fishing location with a purple icon on the map. Follow Cal's fishing questline from there and beat him in the fishing challenge he sets. It is a short, self-contained strand, so take the quest as soon as the text arrives.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one of the four in-game arcade games, called Video Games in-game: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, or Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home by interacting with the controllers, from Chapter 1 onward, and the fourth sits on arcade machines around the world. To complete a game you must finish all of its levels at least once; you do not need to beat every challenge inside it. Pick whichever game suits you best.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's optional questline is exclusive to Lucia and gets marked automatically in Chapter 3. While playing as Lucia you will get a call from Andy, then she texts her home address, marking the strand on the map in Belville. All of it stays available after the story. Finish her five quests in order — Climbing the Cellerichain in three parts, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach! (the Cellerica initiation), Read the Label (retrieving the Cellerica van), and Puff Puff Pass (meeting at the warehouse) — and the trophy pops on the last one.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's optional questline gets marked automatically in Chapter 1. A while after the Chapter 1 main mission Island Dreams, where you work for Kenton, he calls you and is then marked by the green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at shipwrecks: he marks purple treasure-chest icons on the map, you find the treasure on the ocean floor with the metal detector and bring it back to him. In total he wants 7 shipwrecks cleared. Kenton goes quiet after Chapter 1 and returns in Chapter 2 or 3 — as Jason you can speed it up by calling Brian — so the strand is not missable. Track it under Progress, then Characters, then Kenton Rees.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's optional questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. All of it stays available after the story. Finish his five quests in order — Thrillbillies (checking out the mud club), Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler (stealing the Impaler), and Hometown Heroes — and the trophy pops on the last job with Billy.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers found in the open world — but only certain questlines count. PowerPyx warns that many optional questlines do not count toward this trophy, including those of Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie. Confirmed counting strands include Kirk (the Skunk Ape quests: Skunk Apeology 101, searching for tree effigies, and Advanced Skunk Apeonomics), Kyle (McKittrick Farm, collecting chemicals, and checking on Kyle), Yago (street racing and mentoring), and Pilot Pete (The Last Mile quests and his package deliveries), with more strangers still being confirmed. All of them remain available after the story in free roam, and the trophy tracker in the trophy list shows how many you have completed.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's optional questline, Randy's Wish List, is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for Randy and unlock the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered: the Zorrusso is already delivered during that mission, and the rest — from the Pegassi Vitello and Infernus to the Grotti Itali RSX and Bravado Banshee — can be stolen off the street or found at the spots he marks. Track the list under Map, then Robberies, then Randy's Wish List, and deliver each car to his garage at the green RK icon in the west of Vice City. Scanning a car with the WAiNK app tells you whether it is on the list, and a car delivered in good condition pays more. It can all be finished after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's optional questline is only available as Jason and gets marked automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Purple markers appear for the Synthetic Labs in Vice City: go to them and destroy the labs in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter. Once enough labs are destroyed, Tyrone gives his second quest, Spin On This, to shut the labs down — finishing it pops the trophy. Everything stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONLY POSSIBLY MISSABLE TROPHY. There are 18 meditation spots across 10 locations; meditating with both Lucia and Jason at one spot counts as +2. The risk is a single meditation in Chapter 1 at Jason's house: after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she is going to meditate and walks out to the balcony. Follow her, accept the optional quest, and she shows you how. That meditation is gone for good after Chapter 1. PowerPyx had done it when the trophy unlocked, so do it while you can and remove the risk.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's optional questline is exclusive to Jason and gets marked after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break: while playing as Jason you get a text from Bret marking his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. After that he marks hunting spots with purple icons on the map; hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him as Jason. His first quest gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nations, and a clean one-shot kill leaves the animal in pristine condition and pays more. PowerPyx notes it is still unconfirmed which exact animal triggers the trophy, but clearing all 15 of Bret's Target Decks — which the 100% checklist needs anyway — should cover it. Track the decks under Map, then Activities, then Target Deck.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 collectible card sets out of the 18 sets in the game. PowerPyx maps all 18 set locations, so pick the three sets whose cards cluster closest together and sweep those areas in one pass. Cards are a pure collectible: no combat or mission gates them, and the trophy needs only three sets, so leave the other fifteen for the 100% checklist if you are short on patience.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan any 100 WAiNK spots in the world: hold Up to open the WAiNK phone app, look at a scannable object, and hold R1 to scan it. PowerPyx counts 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures among the scannable spots, plus the No Flusher Tags, and there are more than 100 in total, so it does not matter which hundred you scan. Sweep the dense areas of Vice City on foot and the counter climbs fast; the same scans also feed the vehicle-discovery and 100% checklist progress.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% checklist needs any 70 of 80, so this trophy pops automatically on the way to A Long Road. View and track them under Progress, then Challenges, where a checkmark in the bottom right shows a completed one. Many complete naturally while you work on the other trophies, so leave this for late in the run, then pick the easiest and quickest of your remaining challenges to reach 50.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: The earliest this can be done is after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, when Jason and Lucia can free-roam together — call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle. Build a 4-star wanted level by causing carnage, then escape the red heat zone on the map (not just the flashing blue and red search area). PowerPyx's easiest escape is a fast sports motorcycle through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops struggle to follow and the helicopter cannot see you; if a helicopter chases you, shoot it until it leaves. You will also get this naturally during the Chapter 4 bank vault robberies, which always trigger 4 stars, so do not force it early if you would rather wait.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Only possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters and call your partner (hold Right, press Triangle). Rob three robbery targets in a row — the green icons on the map — while staying wanted the whole time, keeping the red and blue flashing wanted level rather than letting it drop. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing items such as Zombix or Adrenaline from Ammu-Nation. PowerPyx notes the unlock is delayed: it pops about half a minute after you leave the third shop, and if it has not popped, hit a fourth shop and keep going. A good spot is the three jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, available after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs; loot a couple of items in each store and break the safe with sticky bombs, and do not leave the first store before the police arrive.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. The game has 557 vehicles at launch — cars, bikes, boats, helicopters and planes — and the easiest way is the WAiNK phone app: hold Up to open it instantly, look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it. You only need to scan a vehicle, not drive it, so stand on a busy road and scan everything that passes. Check your totals under Touchpad, then Progress, then Vehicles. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles scanned, so this trophy comes automatically on the way there.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies inside a single use of Combat Focus, activated with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and vulnerable spots are highlighted, but the purple focus bar drains in a few seconds. Buff your focus first with food, drinks or a wash at home, and consume Adrenaline to extend the slowdown (hold L1, press Triangle). Then line up five enemies — gang members at gang operations count, while soldiers, police and civilians seem not to — and drop them quickly without missing. Wear body armor from Ammu-Nation so you can step out of cover, and use an accurate full-auto rifle such as the Duke 556. Focus has four levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots; at Focus level 4 this is far easier, and it often pops naturally late in the game.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked at a departure terminal at Vice City International Airport — it must be a plane connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not one parked out on the airfield. The easiest is the plane at departure terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head straight for it, and next to the boarding bridge there are stairs with a door leading directly into the plane. Go upstairs, enter the cockpit, drive the plane backward to the airstrip, take off, and fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport before the trophy pops — the unlock is slightly delayed, so keep flying until it appears. You can also walk in through the airport terminal on foot, but the airfield route is faster.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. PowerPyx found them at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County, with the tanks standing in the south of the air base. Drive through the gate or take the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance, climb into a tank and shoot some enemies until the trophy unlocks. Expect heavy resistance on the base, so go in fast and get behind the armor quickly.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. That unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors, and jewelry store robberies, which are then marked automatically in unfogged map areas with a green icon. Break into a store through the back door using the Snap Gun — the gadget stays in your inventory permanently and needs no equipping; approaching a locked door offers the kick (which triggers the alarm) or the Snap Gun for the stealth approach. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, and be sure to destroy the security footage and disable the alarm by interacting with them in the back room. The trophy unlocks shortly after you leave the store. A good location is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, which is marked automatically from story progress and introduces bank vault robberies: tail a security van until it stops at a bank, watch a guard carry a briefcase of cash inside and the vault open, then go in quickly while it is open and rob it. You cannot carry all the cash alone — bring your partner and hold Right to hand off one bag. After that quest you can pay Yasmani, the fence unlocked in Chapter 3, for tips about security vans; if you have not done his earlier quests, do those first (robbing two Payday Loans), then he sells van tips for $10,000 and marks the vans with a purple icon. Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles to become unrecognizable. There are 8 large bank jobs in total; the trophy needs any 5, but the 100% checklist needs all 8, and a single vault can pay up to $205,000.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: This pops automatically in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, the same mission that unlocks bank vault robberies: robbing the vault of a large bank counts as robbing an armored truck, since you tail the truck to the bank first. You can also get it earlier — armored trucks drive around Vice City near banks, so block one's path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the red heat radius (a Pay 'n' Spray helps). Sticky bombs are found in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests, and Yasmani becomes a fence automatically from the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. Since the 100% checklist needs all 8 large bank jobs, the trophy is earned on the way regardless.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map of Leonida. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every area still covered in black fog until the entire map is visible. PowerPyx has a dedicated guide for the fastest unfogging route and the best plane to use. This pairs naturally with the stunt and vehicle-scanning work, since flying the map also passes under bridges and over stunt spots.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 illegal gang operations in total, and the 100% checklist needs all of them, so this trophy comes automatically on that road. Operations are marked by yellow icons on the map when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track them under Progress, then Gangs, where scrolling over a gang shows how many of its operations you have robbed in the bottom right.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar and buy an Apple Martini. Drink it while standing next to the bar, with the Ocean Beach view in front of you, and the trophy unlocks. It is a small, peaceful trophy with no combat and no prerequisite — a good one to grab whenever you are passing Ocean Beach.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal one specific car from one specific showroom and drive it out through the showroom window: the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City. You can only steal it after obtaining the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs. Hack into the car, drive forward and straight through the window — the trophy is slightly delayed and pops after you drive further away on the street. It only unlocks from this blue Banshee, not any other car; it is an easter egg reference to the Banshee from GTA III.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations. Before going there, buy sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation — you need them to blow open the safe. You first visit during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, which is marked automatically in Chapter 2. Inside the bowling alley, pick up the three valuables: the luxury watch in the office in the south-east, the unique shotgun variant Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the office in the north-east hallway, which you blow open with sticky bombs. The trophy unlocks after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item, and killing the enemies is not necessary. If you miss an item during the mission, the robbery icon respawns after a long while and you can go back for what remains — the trophy is not missable and the three items do not need to be taken in one visit.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. This can only be started after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Check strength under Touchpad, then Jason & Lucia, selecting a character and scrolling to Strength (the heart icon). Raise it by working out: buy a membership at a fitness club — filter for them on the map under Activities, the dumbbell icon; there are many across Vice City — and always go together with both characters (hold Right and press Triangle to call your partner). While one character actively works out, the other automatically completes their training too, so you make double progress. You can also work out at home after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile — you can see the count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list. Turn on criminal profile notifications first, under Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, then Criminal Profile, so a small demon face appears on the right of the screen whenever something you do changes your reputation. PowerPyx lists the profiles: Professional for finishing objectives and robberies stealthily and destroying evidence, Hardened for incapacitating enemies without killing them, Violent for killing enemies and civilians, Psycho for killing large numbers of cops and civilians or driving over gravestones, and Irredeemable, a permanent status from excessive violence that makes cops more aggressive. This comes passively while you work on the other trophies and the 100% checklist — every robbery and enemy encounter counts — and if anything is left at the end, it can be farmed quickly by running over civilians and cops with a car.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED AT THE TIME THIS GUIDE WAS WRITTEN. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown and believes it is related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue — the description, 'Second time's the charm', suggests returning to something once more. Do not chase it blind: follow the linked PowerPyx guide, which is being updated as players confirm the method, and check the Payday Loans locations it documents. This entry marks the trophy honestly rather than inventing a method.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. Go to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM, and go alone. The spawn is slightly random: at the roadside you will sometimes find a blinking car. If it is not there, drive away and come back until it is. Next to the blinking car, follow the path into the woods and you will see the UFO as a bright blue light in the sky. Approach it and the UFO drops a woman it abducted; talk to her and offer to help, and she asks you to go back to her car at the roadside. Do that and the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED AT THE TIME THIS GUIDE WAS WRITTEN. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown and believes it comes from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle — a melee attack from a moving vehicle, matching the description 'bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by'. The likely method is to ride a motorcycle past enemies and kick them over, but no guide has confirmed the exact trigger yet. Follow the linked PowerPyx guide for the confirmation when it lands, rather than grinding on a guess. This entry marks the trophy honestly rather than inventing a method.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Credit Check, where you meet Raul's crew — that unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer you need to launder marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 counts across all robberies, so you never need to carry it at once, and it comes naturally while doing robberies for the 100% checklist. The bank vaults alone give up to $205,000 in a single robbery, but those only open after the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is….

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all types of shops. Buying guns, car mods and tattoos is the fastest way there, since those are the most expensive things in the game. PowerPyx counts the shop types: 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores. Just play and buy what you need and the counter climbs; if it is the last trophy standing, a round of car mods and tattoos closes the gap in minutes.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 purchasable garages, for a total of $160,000. The 4 story-related garages do not count. Garages become available after the Chapter 2 main mission Daily Driver, where you steal the Crawler for Moses: you get a notification that a new app is installed on your phone, Vice City Real Estate, and you buy the garages through that app. A quick way to make the money is robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3 and 4. Buy the garages early too, because each one adds parking space you need for On the Spot.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 main mission Moses, where you take a vehicle to Moses. It lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to your location anywhere. To register 10 vehicles you first need enough garage space — see Little Boxes — because each garage adds one or more parking spots. Then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and, in his garage, choose Respray and then Register. At first he only accepts vehicles without trackers; later, in Chapter 3, you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so keep expenses low by choosing cheap low-end cars and bikes.
